raw.title: chore: release v0.4.0
raw.body:
chore: release v0.4.0

Version 0.4.0 across the workspace for the breaking removal of the non-standard $env expression namespace, plus the 0.4.0 CHANGELOG entry and a crate description that no longer pins the spec to 1.0. Cargo.lock is refreshed for the --locked release build. god-files.md joins .gitignore: the register is repo-local agent bookkeeping and stays out of published history per maintainer decision.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
